verification.title: Verification status

banner.UNVERIFIED: Upload a trade licence or national ID to get verified. Until then your job posts stay as drafts.
banner.PENDING: An admin is checking your documents. Your waiting posts will go live as soon as you are approved.
banner.VERIFIED: Your business is verified. You can publish jobs, and every post shows the Verified badge.
banner.REJECTED: Your verification was not approved. Fix the problem below and upload the document again.

verification.changeWarning: Changing the business name or the document after approval sends your profile for review again.
verification.badgeExplain: An admin has checked this employer's trade licence or national ID.
